name: oche-scorer
description: Darts scorer and trainer for the web, iOS and Android

scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.icons: swift scripts/make-icons.swift icon 1024 web/icons/icon-1024.png && swift scripts/make-icons.swift mask 512 web/icons/maskable-512.png && swift scripts/make-icons.swift splash 2732 store/splash-2732.png && for n in 512 192 32; do sips -Z $n web/icons/icon-1024.png --out web/icons/icon-$n.png; done && mv web/icons/icon-32.png web/icons/favicon-32.png && sips -Z 180 web/icons/icon-1024.png --out web/icons/apple-touch-icon.png && cp web/icons/icon-1024.png ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon-512@2x.png && for f in splash-2732x2732 splash-2732x2732-1 splash-2732x2732-2; do cp store/splash-2732.png ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/Splash.imageset/$f.png; done
